baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated second-person plural verb in لا تبصرون is anchored at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The eye-sight branch makes the relative clause collect realities that fail to enter the audience's present visual field. The limit belongs first to the observers, not necessarily to the things.

activation_trace.role: Seeing with the eye supplies the literal perceptual threshold that the negation places the referent beyond.

changed_reading.before: A generic label for unseen things.
changed_reading.after: Whatever is not entering your present bodily field of view, without implying that it is unreal or permanently invisible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تبصرون can activate the root's inward-sight branch while remaining the focus verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: Negated inner sight extends the clause from optical absence to truths not penetrated, verified, recognized, or admitted by the heart, including what a person fails to witness about the self.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight supplies cognitive penetration and self-witness as the nonvisual capacity being negated.

changed_reading.before: Things physically hidden from the eyes.
changed_reading.after: Also what you do not inwardly recognize or verify even when clues could be available.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root includes a branch for a small blood piece, streak, or amount close enough to inspect.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sight becomes forensic rather than panoramic: a reality can be missed because its residual mark is minute, erased, or not examined. The negative clause can therefore include absent or subvisible evidence.

activation_trace.role: The inspectable blood trace supplies a minute material residue whose detection would make a hidden event legible.

changed_reading.before: An unseen object with no visual evidence.
changed_reading.after: A reality whose event is not seen and whose remaining trace may also escape inspection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root's armor and shield branch remains attached to تبصرون.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visible defensive surface can make an interior unavailable to sight. On this material model, not seeing is produced by interposition and protection rather than distance or darkness.

activation_trace.role: Shield or armor supplies a bright protective exterior that functionally occludes what it covers.

changed_reading.after: What is present but screened by a protective or interposing layer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root includes the thick edge and stitched joining of two hides or panels.
baseline_models.mechanism: An assembled surface depends on joins that can disappear into the finished whole. The unseen can be the connective edge or internal construction that lets the visible object hold together.

activation_trace.role: The thick stitched edge supplies a concealed connective structure beneath an apparently continuous visible surface.

changed_reading.after: Some unseen realities are the joins already operating inside what appears whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding oath repeats the same sight root positively, while the partition branch of قسم makes the two adjacent ما-clauses read as allotted shares. The focus clause becomes the complementary remainder of the visible share rather than an isolated topic.

activation_trace.role: Negated eye-sight supplies the second perceptual class named by the focus clause.
Apportioning and dividing supplies the mechanism by which the oath-domain is distributed into visible and nonvisible shares.
Positive eye-sight supplies the matched first share against which the negated focus verb is measured.

structural_cues: 69:38 and 69:39 are adjacent oath objects with matched ما-clauses and the same second-person plural sight verb.
Only the focus member carries لا, producing a positive-negative pair rather than two unrelated objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an oath, a division branch, and matched sight clauses. I supply the arrow from formal pairing to a potentially exhaustive partition. A live alternative is emphatic contrast without strict logical exhaustiveness.

changed_reading.before: What you do not see is a freestanding unseen category.
changed_reading.after: It is the complementary allotment to what you see, so the oath reaches the visual share and everything left outside it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence moves from an audible saying to a commended messenger and then to delivery from a sovereign source. This activates a layered communication model: wording and bearer may be encountered, while origin, authorization, and the path of transmission are not objects of direct sight.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight supplies the nonocular discernment needed to assess a message's source and authorization.
Uttered speech supplies the perceptible output whose nonvisible provenance remains in question.
Messenger and message supply the mediating link between heard wording and a source beyond direct sight.
Commended honor supplies a credibility property of the transmitter without making the transmitter the ultimate source.
Caused descent and delivery supply the directional path by which the saying reaches its recipients.
Sovereignty and lordship supply the asserted authorizing source at the far end of the transmission chain.

structural_cues: 69:40 names saying, messenger, and his quality before 69:43 names descent and source.
The intervening denials classify possible human production channels rather than describing a visible object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an utterance, mediator, delivery, and sovereign source. I supply the arrow that treats their sequence as a provenance chain placed within the nonvisual half of the oath. The live alternative is that these clauses only identify the text and do not specify what 69:39 denotes.

changed_reading.before: The unseen consists mainly of hidden entities or scenes.
changed_reading.after: It also includes the unobserved provenance, authorization, and transmission history behind words that are heard.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inner-sight baseline could drift into unrestricted hidden knowledge, but the nearby denial of a soothsayer's saying explicitly names and rejects that production mode. The unseen remains live while a familiar claimant to hidden reports is excluded.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight supplies the broad hidden-knowledge reading that the context then constrains.
Spoken saying supplies the candidate verbal channel whose classification is being denied.
A soothsayer reporting hidden news supplies the precise occult channel that the sequence excludes.

structural_cues: 69:41 and 69:42 successively deny poet and soothsayer as source classes.
The soothsayer denial follows immediately after the visible-nonvisible oath pair and the messenger claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a denial and a branch explicitly tied to hidden reports. I supply the arrow from that denial to narrowing the broad inner-sight baseline. An alternative is that only the messenger's identity is defended while the scope of 69:39 remains unrestricted.

changed_reading.before: Anything outside ordinary sight may be filled in by an alleged specialist in hidden news.
changed_reading.after: The unseen clause does not license generic divination; the context makes the legitimacy of the reporting channel decisive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated saying root includes speech held inwardly and not manifested, while the later knowledge and denial roots make false attribution inspectable as a hidden relation among wording, intention, and claimed source. What cannot be seen may therefore be an authorial act rather than an object.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight supplies access to intention and attribution that bodily vision cannot directly inspect.
Speech retained within the self supplies an unmanifest layer behind sayings that become publicly attributed.
Disclosure to a knower supplies access to the hidden relation that the audience cannot see directly.
Attributing falsity to a thing or speaker supplies the contested judgment about unseen authorship and intent.

structural_cues: 69:44 frames fabricated sayings counterfactually, while 69:49 asserts knowledge of deniers within the audience.
Neither intention nor true attribution is available as a simple visual property of the uttered words.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unmanifest speech, knowing, and false attribution. I supply the arrow that places intention and authorship inside the oath's nonvisual domain. A live alternative is that the saying branches concern only overt fabrication, not inward speech.

changed_reading.before: What is unseen is external to the speaking event.
changed_reading.after: The unseen can be the intention, attribution, and authorship relation operating behind audible language.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hypothetical false attribution is followed by seizure, severing the life-artery, and the absence of any interposing barrier. This gives the focus root's blood-trace branch a causal setting: an invisible authorship violation would be converted into an unmistakable bodily residue and loss of life.

activation_trace.role: The small visible blood trace supplies the evidentiary residue by which a previously hidden act could become bodily legible.
Saying or attributing what did not exist supplies the hidden initiating violation in the conditional chain.
Seizure and capture supply the first embodied consequence that constrains the alleged speaker.
Severing and separation supply the irreversible conversion from hidden false attribution to physical rupture.
The life-artery supplies the specific bodily conduit whose cutting would leave a fatal, inspectable consequence.
An interposing separator supplies the protective interruption that the clause says no audience member could provide.

structural_cues: 69:44-47 form one counterfactual sequence from fabricated speech through bodily consequence to failed intervention.
The causal issue is authorship, while the threatened verification is explicitly corporeal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the conditional claim and its bodily sequence. I supply the arrow that treats bodily consequence as making hidden authorship evidentially legible. The live alternative is pure sanction without an epistemic or trace-making function.

changed_reading.before: The unseen is disembodied and leaves no inspectable remainder.
changed_reading.after: A hidden falsification can be known by the bodily trace and irreversible consequence it would generate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence activates a material epistemology beneath its overt affective and confessional terms: covering hides truth, removal of a cover exposes, truth is made manifest, and certainty stabilizes knowledge. Thus some nonseeing is produced and can be reversed rather than defining a permanent unseen realm.

activation_trace.role: Eye-sight supplies the perceptual state that covering withholds and uncovering can restore.
Removing a cover supplies the latent disclosure motion inside the overt language of regret.
Veiling truth supplies the human act that makes a reality functionally unseen without erasing it.
Establishing and displaying truth supplies the reversal of concealment in the following clause.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the cognitive state reached after disclosure.

structural_cues: 69:50 places regret and coverers together; 69:51 immediately answers with truth and certainty.
The focus negates seeing by the audience, while the later sequence changes the epistemic condition rather than the referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cover, uncover, manifest truth, and stable knowledge branches. I supply the directional chain from occlusion through disclosure to certainty. An alternative is that these are independent lexical histories and the surface sequence carries only regret, unbelief, truth, and certainty.

changed_reading.before: Not seeing marks a fixed ontological class.
changed_reading.after: It can mark truth made unavailable by covering, with a live transition from occlusion to exposure and certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence denies every last-minute interposer and then names reminder as serving those who place themselves in protection. Joined to the focus armor branch, this distinguishes preventive receptivity from an imagined shield that could block consequence after falsification.

activation_trace.role: Armor supplies the material model of a defense that can hide an interior or attempt to intercept force.
Exhaustive negation supplies the universal failure of any person to serve as a protecting exception.
A separating barrier supplies the precise defensive function declared unavailable after the violation.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the prior reception through which protection can begin.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the viable anticipatory defense contrasted with failed interposition.

structural_cues: 69:47 denies a blocker; 69:48 immediately identifies recipients characterized by self-protection.
The order permits a temporal distinction between receiving warning beforehand and blocking consequence afterward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed interposition followed by reminder and self-protection. I supply the temporal arrow that separates preventive protection from impossible rescue after the fact. A live alternative is that حاجزين and متقين are unrelated social and moral descriptions.

changed_reading.before: A hidden shield simply keeps danger from view.
changed_reading.after: Nonvisual protection is possible as prior receptive conduct, but no concealed barrier can cancel consequence once the decisive breach occurs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from fabricated sayings and a portion, through a cutting verb whose branch inventory includes segmented speech, to truth whose branch includes tightly woven wording. Activated by the focus seam, this yields a textual-integrity model: hidden authenticity is the quality of how discourse joins and holds together.

activation_trace.role: The stitched join supplies the focus-anchored model for coherence that is structural rather than directly visible.
Attributing sayings that did not exist supplies the counterfeit discourse whose hidden construction is at issue.
A divided portion supplies the fragmentary unit from which the hypothetical sayings are assembled.
Cut or segmented speech supplies a cross-domain image of discourse broken into pieces, although the surface verb cuts a body.
Tightly woven speech supplies the opposing image of true discourse whose parts hold together.

structural_cues: 69:44 explicitly combines fabricated saying with some or part, while 69:51 closes by naming truth.
The bodily cutting in 69:46 sits between the fragmentary-saying and tightly-woven-truth activations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies portioned sayings, a speech-segmentation branch, a woven-truth branch, and the focus seam. I supply the arrow from these material images to hidden textual integrity. The strong alternative is that the cut is exclusively anatomical and no discourse-weaving contrast is intended.

changed_reading.before: The unseen is only the external source of speech.
changed_reading.after: It may also be the unobserved integrity of the discourse itself: whether its parts are fabricated fragments or a fitted, truth-bearing weave.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus branch names soft bright stone-ground, something expected to be visible, and because the context cues come through world and name forms. It remains anchored in the focus root and exact packet branches for distinguishing and visible marks: the paradox allows failure to see through inattention while marks still point beyond themselves. Downstream prose should present it as a semiotic and attentional analogy, not as a lexical replacement for تبصرون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The bright-stone branch of ب ص ر turns the focus negation into a question of registering a marked surface, not only receiving light.

activation_trace.role: Soft bright stone-ground supplies a plainly available surface that can nevertheless go unregistered by attention.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies indirect evidence pointing beyond what is immediately seen.
The non-dominant mapped branch of a visible identifying mark makes the name function as a sign rather than the referent itself.

changed_reading.before: Not seeing must result from darkness, distance, or total absence of signs.
changed_reading.after: A referent may remain unseen even while bright or marked surfaces indirectly indicate it, because attention stops at or misses the sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the focus root's weaponry sense and reads protection spatially. It remains anchored through the armor branch and context branches for being bare of protection and placing oneself in protection: a visible defense implies an interior that is both hidden and vulnerable. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy and keep it distinct from the ordinary moral sense of متقين.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus armor branch makes a visible covering the boundary across which the protected interior is not seen.

activation_trace.role: Shining shield or armor supplies the visible exterior from which a concealed vulnerable interior is inferred.
Putting the self into protection supplies the interior-exterior relation modeled by armor.
Being stripped bare of protection supplies the reversal in which the formerly concealed interior is exposed.

changed_reading.before: The nonvisible is simply remote from every visible surface.
changed_reading.after: A visible protective surface can itself testify to the hidden, vulnerable interior that it covers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a stitched edge in the focus inventory to anatomy rather than treating it as an optical sense. It remains anchored because the packet places severing beside the life-artery: both branches describe concealed connective structures whose failure reveals their prior work. Downstream prose should qualify it as a structural analogy, not claim that بصر literally means artery or seam here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus branch for joining two panels anchors a reading of unseen connective infrastructure inside a visible whole.

activation_trace.role: The thick joined edge supplies a hidden connection on which an assembled exterior depends.
Severing supplies the failure operation that reveals how much the unseen connection had been carrying.
The life-artery supplies an internal conduit whose ordinarily unseen continuity sustains the visible body.

changed_reading.before: Unseen realities are separate objects outside the visible whole.
changed_reading.after: They can be hidden joins and lifelines whose continuous operation is what lets the visible whole remain intact.

strongest_changes: The paired sight clauses and the partition branch of قسم changed 69:39 into the complementary remainder of an oath spanning visible and nonvisible shares.
The saying-messenger-descent sequence moved the unseen from hidden objects toward provenance, authorization, intention, and transmission behind audible words.
The fabricated-saying counterfactual activated the blood-trace branch: hidden authorship would become bodily legible through seizure, severing, and an exposed life-artery.
The cover-uncover-truth-certainty sequence made some nonseeing reversible occlusion rather than a permanent ontology.
summary.what_was_special: Rare branches of ب ص ر produced mechanisms rather than decorations: blood trace became evidence, armor became interposition, a stitched edge became hidden integrity, and bright ground became an indirect-mark problem. These coexist with the strong ocular and inward-sight readings rather than replacing them.
remaining_uncertainties: The visible and nonvisible pair may be rhetorically comprehensive without forming a strict exhaustive partition.
The provenance reading is strongly sequenced but the packet does not explicitly equate the oath's nonvisible member with source or transmission.
Blood, armor, seam, segmented-speech, and bright-ground activations are packet-anchored but remain cross-domain analogies rather than secure lexical glosses.
The cover-to-disclosure chain may be a reader-supplied material alignment across conventional terms rather than an intended optical progression.
